text:
mikael: FYI Starboard Logistics just messaged — cooling-loop maintenance at SIN-3 will reduce GPU intake rate for 24-48h, affects H100 inbound and RMA processing. Can we re-route or hold?
shweta: Ugh. We had 12 H100s scheduled for depot staging today (PO-4712). How many can the depot accept if cooling is throttled?
starboard-bot: @mikael @shweta Depot SIN-3 acceptance currently reduced to 4 units/hour; recommended hold for non-critical replacements.
ben: If acceptance drops that low we should convert 6 units to air-expedite to SGN hub and route to SIN-5 depot. Air adds ~$2.2k/unit but keeps SLAs.
elaine: Cost note — finance ok with one-off expedite if it's customer-facing replacements. Need approval for anything > $10k.
mikael: Ok split plan: hold 4 units at SIN-3 staging (prioritize urgent RMAs), expedite 6 units via air to SGN, leave 2 as week-of replenishment. @rma-coordinator can you tag urgent RMAs?
rma-coordinator: Tagged 3 urgent RMAs (cust A, cust B, cust C). Will allocate the SIN-3 slots to those. Rest go to air.
shweta: Vendor asks for AWB/labeling cutoff — need to confirm customs HS code for expedited shipment to VN. Previously used HS:8473.30. Do we reconfirm?
ben: Yes HS:8473.30 still valid. Starboard asked for packed dims/weight. Payload per H100 crate: 30kg, dims 110x40x30cm, 80cm with pallet.
elaine: I updated the PO amendment: PO-4712-AIRX. Added shipping uplift line item + approval. Attach invoice ref INV-9921.
starboard-bot: AWB created: SB-APAC-87654321. ETA SGN hub 2025-05-12 10:00 local. Customs docs attached to vendor portal.
mikael: Good — can we also expedite the RMA labels for the three urgent customers? We want same-day swap.
rma-coordinator: Printed labels for those RMAs. RMA refs: RMA-9981, RMA-9982, RMA-9983. I'll push pickup window 14:00-16:00.
shweta: Quick check — depot inventory command: ```curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://infra.internal/api/depot?site=sin-3&sku=h100" | jq .available``` returns 6 (includes the 4 accepted + 2 held).
ben: If that returns 6 then routing math works. Can we also reserve 2 spare H100s for FRU swaps in case any DOA?
mikael: Reserve 2 spares in SIN-5 after air arrival. Shweta add a note to the dispatch: "hold 2 FRU spares for on-call swaps".
elaine: Logistics tax/customs: Starboard flagged potential broker surcharge if we reclassify HS mid-route. Recommend we keep HS consistent.
shweta: Noted. I'll confirm with Starboard to keep HS:8473.30 unchanged.
starboard-bot: Vendor update: one crate flagged for minor foam damage on inspection. They recommend swapping foam + reboxing at SGN to avoid customs hold. Additional handling fee estimated $180/crate.
ben: Approve rebox if it avoids hold. Add to PO amendment.
mikael: Action items — 1) Starboard to ship 6 via air AWB SB-APAC-87654321, 2) SIN-3 hold 4 units for urgent RMAs, 3) reserve 2 spares at SIN-5 after arrival, 4) approve $180 rebox if needed, 5) keep HS 8473.30.
elainE: :thumbsup: (typo corrected below) — will handle PO tweaks and payment.
rma-coordinator: Will update RMA tickets and confirm pickup times. Final ETA for urgent swaps 2025-05-12 18:00 SGT.
mikael: Thanks team. If anything slips tag me and add #ops-escalation.
